output.explanation: Checked the unchanged checkout at commit 8ca143700ca4d2c870f1101b8cd4601ab68abd41. The central diagram now follows ownership from App through workspace, draft session, controller, snapshot and document contents. Mounted editors remain page-owned consumers, not children of sessions. Two peripheral diagrams elaborate history/persistence/publication and backend collaborators, with connections at the relevant operations. Source corrections: diagramRevisionStore is a shared runtime registry, not owned by CanvasHistory; GenerationCanvasBridge is shared backend wiring, not owned by AgentChatService; PromptComposerCoordinator polls requests while backend-dispatched receivers apply revisions; proposal acceptance checks the live baseline and publishes through the catalog rather than directly overwriting live drafts. These relationships were checked in canvasWorkspace.ts, canvasSession.ts, mappingDocumentController.ts, MappingEditorCanvas.tsx, canvasHistoryService.ts, workspacePersistence.ts, promptComposerCoordinator.ts, changeSessionService.ts and bootstrap.ts.

        |       |-- Read-only document/presentation/selection/controls/geometry/status stores
        |       |-- Saved baseline: name + scene + edges determine dirty status
        |       |-- cursorCopy: pending pasted content
        |       |-- onCommit() -> workspace.onPersist() -> WorkspacePersistence
        |       `-- MappingDocumentController: semantic command boundary
        |           |-- CanvasEditingContext handle -> shared history service
        |           |-- ControllerSnapshot
        |           |   |-- MappingGridDocument
        |           |   |   |-- LineGridScene
        |           |   |   |   |-- Root container -> nested containers/diagram instances
        |           |   |   |   `-- Contents: immutable Diagram references
        |           |   |   |       |-- Identity/revision + highlights + jumps
        |           |   |   |       |-- DiagramContent: ASCII + pinned parser structure
        |           |   |   |       `-- DiagramSourceContext: binding/hash/mappings/evidence
        |           |   |   |           `-- forSelection() -> source ranges for source panes
        |           |   |   `-- Edges/jumps, presentations, contexts, alternatives/reviews
        |           |   `-- MappingCanvasState

        |       `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas: application overlay
        |           |-- SelectionLayer/Actions, SelectionEffectsLayer, CursorCopyOverlay
        |           `-- Node/region/subtree, highlight and clipboard actions -> controller
        |-- Navigation and review surfaces
        |   |-- MappingDiagramExplorer, MappingSubmenu, FloatingPane and WindowPanel

        |-- PromptComposerCoordinator
        |   |-- Prompt drafts, captured references, exact retries and polling timers

        |-- useAgentCanvasBridge: register/poll/execute/reply; unregister on cleanup

History, workspace persistence and publication

|   |   `-- CanvasHistory

|-- WorkspacePersistence (page-owned adapter; workspacePersistence.ts)

|   |-- workspace.onPersist() -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState.captureDisplay/captureCamera -> view records
|   |-- Index: active document, document IDs and transfer transactions
|   `-- Deduplicated deltas + metadata + baseline + views -> RecordStorage.batch()
|-- WorkspaceStorage (client service; workspaceStorage.ts)
|   |-- RecordStorage: record state, batching, write/flush status
|   `-- One worker -> /api/mapping/workspace/records -> MappingWorkspaceService
|-- Backend workspace persistence (wired by createBackend)

`-- Published representations (separate from workspace UI records)
    |-- MappingDiagramService: initialize/save/publishCheckpoint/delete

Backend collaborators (src/server/app/bootstrap.ts: createBackend)
|

|-- GenerationCanvasBridge: shared CanvasSessionPort, not owned by AgentChatService
|   |-- Isolated contexts: controller + receipts + queue + persistence callback
|   |   `-- Same domain commands/history; browser selection is unchanged
|   `-- Held live port: CanvasSessionBridge
|       `-- dispatch -> browser useAgentCanvasBridge -> workspace controllers
|-- LiveCanvasService: availability and published selection reads
|-- AgentContextService -> AgentContextLibrary: reusable source/context snapshots
|-- AgentChatService
|   |-- Injected Codex connection, FileChatStore, ChatDiagramTools and MCP binding
|   `-- Candidate generation -> shared GenerationCanvasBridge
|-- SelectionService / LocalChatService
|   `-- Captured ASCII + selection + source evidence -> Pi/Codex runtime adapters
|-- ChangeSessionService (application/mapping/changes/changeSessionService.ts)
|   |-- Private history service + per-session mutation queues
|   |-- Stored sessions: baseline/proposed documents, pinned Git context and receipts
|   |-- Proposal mutation -> headless MappingDocumentController, separate from drafts
|   |   `-- Uses same history model as live workspace, but separate contexts
|   `-- accept(): validate proposal version + live baseline + saved catalog revision

|-- PushIntegrationService -> DiffSessionWorkflowService -> change proposals
|-- Comparison/evaluation services (separate /evals UI)

|-- FileCompactionService
|   |-- Compaction workflow, injected agent runtime and FileCompactionStore
|   `-- Source-validated representations -> CoreApplication / project catalog
`-- Backend lifecycle: routes + shared stores/runtimes; dispose stops tasks and bridges
